create_triangular_schedule: create a triangular cyclical learning rate scheduler with configurable min and max learning rates
configure_triangular_args: configure triangular lr scheduler command line arguments including max-lr, lr-period-updates, and shrink-min
step_triangular_lr: step the triangular learning rate scheduler after each training update to adjust the optimizer's learning rate
step_epoch_triangular_lr: step the triangular learning rate scheduler at epoch boundaries without changing the learning rate
register_triangular_scheduler: register the triangular lr scheduler with fairseq's scheduler registry for use via --lr-scheduler=triangular
